title: ChatGPT and Patient Safety in the Nuclear Medicine Thyroid Outpatient Clinic
summary: Due to the increasing availability of easily accessible, free, and publicly available AI systems, their use by patients is expected to rise. We aim to examine the implications this has for patient safety, communication with patients, and the resulting consequences for their further treatment - here with regard to nuclear medicine thyroid diagnostics.

interventions.name: Retrospective, single-arm analysis as part of basic research on pattern recognition and analysis using AI.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Study conducted in the thyroid outpatient clinic of the Department of Nuclear Medicine, Aachen
• Inclusion in one of six subgroups (1. Normal finding, 2. Unifocal autonomy, 3. Multifocal autonomy, 4. Disseminated autonomy, 5. Graves’ disease, 6. Hypofunctioning nodule)
• Availability of complete imaging, laboratory, and report data
Exclusion criteria:
• Insufficient image quality
• Incomplete datasets (missing laboratory values, reports, or imaging data)
